specialLock.prompt: The shell-lock asks what the sea cannot keep.

customItems.name: Pearl Warrant
customItems.description: A pearl holding a perfectly preserved accusation against the tide court.
customItems.customDescription: A pearl holding a perfectly preserved accusation against the tide court.

intro.text: The river has begun repossessing houses for debts no one signed. A pearl warrant lies somewhere beneath the tide court, proof that the Queen of the Crushing Deep forged the current’s authority.

outro.text: When the warrant leaves the court, the river gives back three stolen doorsteps, a chapel bell, and one confused goat. The Queen’s tide still roars, but now it has paperwork to fear.

storyTriggers.title: Drowned Ledger Dock
storyTriggers.text: Water laps against ledgers chained to the dock. Each page lists a debt in someone else’s handwriting.

storyTriggers.title: Counting Pool
storyTriggers.text: Coins circle the pool bottom in tidy spirals. They refuse to be counted by anyone with dry lungs.

storyTriggers.title: Pearl Warrant
storyTriggers.text: The pearl opens like an eye and shows a tide court seal being pressed onto a blank accusation.

storyTriggers.title: Queen Tide Court
storyTriggers.text: The Queen of the Crushing Deep rises with a crown made of pressure and broken oaths.

storyTriggers.title: Secrets Leak
storyTriggers.text: The vault exhales trapped bubbles. Each one whispers a name the sea tried to keep.

designNotes.hiddenDoor: Evidence vault path to court is hidden to reward inspection.
